passage:
Mia's family bought a chocolate cake for her brother's birthday. After dinner, there was one piece left. Everyone said they were too full, so Mia put it in the refrigerator.
The next morning, the cake was gone.
Mia thought her brother ate it. Her brother thought their father ate it. Their father thought their mother ate it. Everyone blamed someone else.
Later, Mia found a small plate on the kitchen floor. Their dog, Lucky, was sleeping under the table with chocolate on his nose. The family laughed, but Mia's mother became worried because chocolate can be dangerous for dogs.
Lucky was fine, but the family learned two things that day. First, do not blame people too quickly. Second, never leave cake where a smart dog can reach it.
